title: The Space calendar Week, Day and Agenda views, with drag, 15 minute snap, Undo, the now line and Inbox drop

source.ref: Daniel, 2026-10-28: redesign the Space calendar with the Calendar system handoff; every Space gets the full calendar and project suite (pass 3 of 9)

detail: Pass 3 of the Space calendar and project suite: the real Week and Day time grid (7 AM to 11 PM at 52px an hour, growing for anything outside, lanes per overlap cluster, an all-day row, a now line with an orb, a clash flag on anything that lands on Unavailable), the Agenda with real drop targets, a partner Space pill and an owner avatar, and drag and drop in Month, Week, Day and Agenda. A drop moves a date through saveCalendarEntry (the one entry write, which carries a Plan's to-dos), one date of a repeating entry through saveCalendarEntryOccurrence, and an Inbox to-do through a new moveSpaceTodo that updates the same to-do. Every drop is shown at once, then written; a toast offers Undo, which is one write that restores the snapshot; and a repeating date asks which dates it reaches on every drop path. Shift with an arrow moves the focused date. Read-only people cannot drag. Not stored yet: the start time of a to-do dropped on a time (crm_tasks has no start column on main, so only the due day is written and the toast says so; pass 2 adds the column). Not undoable: one date of a series, which splits the series in a single database call that has no single reverse. Published events keep date-move.ts's sentence: open the event to change its date. Plan: /mnt/project-files/calendar-suite/PLAN.md.

verify.note: Fails on main and on pass 1 (no Week or Day grid, no drop planner, no moves hook); passes here. The drop and Undo tests run in CI.
